anomalies.name: Veil Mist
anomalies.description: Blue-green mist swallows the sound of careful footsteps.

anomalies.name: Echo Rain
anomalies.description: Each drop repeats through distant rooms and wakes the masonry.

anomalies.name: Nesting Pollen
anomalies.description: Warm golden pollen quickens every egg carried through the floor.

anomalies.name: Mending Lights
anomalies.description: Patient lantern motes gather wherever the expedition makes camp.

anomalies.name: Crystal Bloom
anomalies.description: Violet seams push forgotten material out of sealed caches.

anomalies.name: Hunter Tracks
anomalies.description: Fresh golden prints circle the party even when the corridors are empty.
